children: (NYSE: ZETA), the intelligent AI infrastructure company, today unveiled an expanded speaker lineup and programming agenda for Zeta Live 2026, taking place Thursday, October 8 at David Geffen Hall, Lincoln Center in New York City. Zeta Live will explore how intelligent AI infrastructure is reshaping the way enterprises make decisions, engage customers and drive growth. The sixth annual conference will convene more than 1,800 attendees spanning CMOs, AI executives and senior marketing leaders from global brands, with more than 100 speakers across four stages.

"Every CEO is being asked how AI will change their business. Turning that potential into growth takes intelligent AI infrastructure,” said David A. Steinberg, Co-Founder, Chairman and CEO of Zeta Global. "At Zeta Live, we're bringing together leaders building that infrastructure and putting it to work to explore what it takes to make better decisions, deliver better customer experiences and produce measurable results."
Additional speaker and programming highlights include:
How companies are putting AI and modern infrastructure to work to drive measurable growth, with senior leaders from Palantir, OpenAI, NVIDIA, Microsoft and more.
How brands are using customer intelligence to build stronger relationships and business outcomes, with senior leaders from Steve Madden, Ulta, SharkNinja, AT&T, Pizza Hut and more.

Candid conversations on building enduring brands in times of change and the role of creativity in business, with participants like CEO and Founder, Russell Westbrook Enterprises, Russell Westbrook; entrepreneur and global superstar Kevin Hart; Olympic Gold Medalist and Philanthropist Lindsey Vonn; Chairman, Milken Institute, Michael Milken; Chairman Emeritus at Zeta Global John Sculley; Emmy, Grammy, and NAACP Image Award winning actress, Tiffany Haddish, and more.
Live demos, masterclasses, real-world case studies, as well as exclusive networking experiences and book signings.

Following the day’s programming, Zeta Live will continue with an invite-only evening at the American Museum of Natural History, opening with performances by Steve Aoki and Aloe Blacc and followed by an interactive performance by mentalist Oz Pearlman.
The full Zeta Live 2026 agenda, speaker lineup and information on requesting an invitation are available

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the intelligent AI infrastructure company helping enterprises transform proprietary data into enterprise intelligence. The Zeta Data Cloud and Athena by Zeta™ connect proprietary enterprise knowledge with advanced AI to enable better decisions, more effective customer engagement, and stronger business outcomes. With one of the industry's largest proprietary data assets, Zeta helps organizations accelerate AI transformation and build durable competitive advantage. Founded in 2007 by David A.
